$comment: Acceptance fixture for any model that wants to claim VSON-extractor support. Each entry references an image bundled with the studio. A model passes if at least ceil(0.8 x 4) = 4 of the 4 envelopes conform on first try (no repair retry) and node/edge counts fall within the recorded ranges. A fifth image was withdrawn on 2026-08-04 (spec/CHANGELOG.md) and its fixture went with it; first_try_pass_rate_min is unchanged, so the shorter list makes the bar stricter, never looser.
